name: @edam/verifier-cli
description: Independent offline evidence verifier CLI (EDAM-T146). Impure boundary: reads an Evidence Export Package + a sidecar object bundle + an out-of-band trust file, hydrates VerifierSegments, and runs the pure @edam/verifier §10 procedure. Verifies the export envelope signature (recomputed package_hash, out-of-band trust roots). Exit 0=PASS, 1=integrity failure, 2=usage/parse/schema error. Export mode first; WORM mode minimal.
